body.justification: The finite-action softmax derivatives expose both the envelope and polynomial entropy constants, while the one-dimensional optimizer path turns them into a quantitative conditional multiplier bound.
body.gap: BelloniChernozhukovChetverikovWei2018 assumes a suitable estimated-score approximation and entropy bound; it does not derive this bound for fold-specific influences composed with a same-sample implicit softmax optimizer path.
body.consumer: The open replacement question can focus on the shrinking empirical radius, after which a conditional maximal inequality yields multiplier replacement without treating overlapping training complements as independent.
